name: Courting Death
source:
Life at Midsommar University has been rather mundane; you mostly bum around campus and go out drinking with your roommate Lin on the weekends.  At the end of an extended bender, you meet a girl who delivers to you something you could have never imagined: you've been cursed to die come Friday.

You learn that there is one way to break free: the curse can pass through lover's lips, saving you but condemning your partner.

[From [url=https://jennahveer.itch.io/courting-death]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
仲夏玛大学的生活相​​当平凡。你大部分时间都在校园里闲逛，周末和你的室友林一起出去喝酒。在一次长时间的狂欢结束时，你遇到了一个女孩，她给了你一些你从未想象过的东西：你被诅咒在周五就会死。

你了解到只有一种方法可以摆脱束缚：咒语可以通过爱人的嘴唇传递，拯救你，但谴责你的伴侣。

[来自[url=https://jennahveer.itch.io/courting-death]Itch.io[/url]]
